Psalm 139 — YHWH has searched me and known me

descriptions.en:
An English translation of the five psalms that the Raëlian canon cites: **Psalm 8** (a mortal made 'a little less than Elohim'), **Psalm 19** (the skies recount the glory of El), **Psalm 33** (YHWH looks down from the heavens on all the sons of the human), **Psalm 139** (YHWH has searched me and known me) and **Psalm 147** (he counts the number of the stars). Verse numbers follow the Hebrew, in which a psalm's heading is verse 1. The rest of the book is not translated.

Source: Sefaria v3 API, Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra (Westminster Leningrad Codex base, Public Domain); Ketiv/Qere sites translate the Qere and are noted. Reference translation: ASV (1901). Proper names are given in their English forms.
